cc:Work.dc:title: FlexBox - ShutterBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Box with a rolling shutter made of flex
Beware of the rolling shutter effect! Use wax on sliding surfaces.
![Inside](static/samples/ShutterBox-3.jpg)
![Detail](static/samples/ShutterBox-2.jpg)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes ShutterBox --x 90 --y 160 --h 110 --radius 30 --thickness 3 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes ShutterBox --x --y --h --radius --reference
